cohort: Antenatal cases with term singleton pregnancies admitted to a tertiary care centre who underwent emergency caesarean delivery.
finding: Booked antenatal patients showed better maternal and perinatal outcomes in terms of mortality compared to unbooked patients.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean sections were more frequent among booked mothers, and hypotension and PPH were common intraoperative complications for both booked and unbooked mothers undergoing this mode of birth.
